card.title: SYKES REGULARS
card.text: Draw 3 cards when this unit moves into the frontline.
card.flavorText: The 20th Infantry Regiment, nicknamed "Sykes' Regulars" after Civil War General George Sykes, is a US Army unit established in 1861. During WWII, as part of the 6th Infantry Division, the regiment was engaged in bitter jungle and mountain fighting throughout the Pacific campaigns. They landed at Maffin Bay on 11 June 1944, and took part in the Battle of Lone Tree Hill, a decisive engagement in the Western New Guinea Campaign. In January 1945, they joined General MacArthur’s return to Luzon, in the Philippines, storming Blue Beach at Lingayen Gulf. There, they faced well-equipped Japanese troops entrenched in strong defensive positions, and the Pacific’s biggest armor concentration. They helped secure key strategic objectives, contributing significantly to the Allied victory in the Pacific. Later, they battled remaining enemy forces on Munoz Island until the 15 August 1945 ceasefire. The Sykes Regulars had 219 days of continuous combat and they were, along with other members of the 6th Division, the most heavily engaged unit in the United States Army during WWII.
